# Vorix Food Ingredients

> Premium dehydrated vegetables, spices and seasonings from Mahuva, Gujarat, India.

## About
Vorix Food Ingredients supplies dependable dehydrated ingredients for food makers, with sourcing close to the crop and controlled processing, sorting and packing.

## Products
- Dehydrated white onion: flakes, chopped, minced, granules and powder
- Dehydrated pink onion: flakes, chopped, minced, granules and powder
- Dehydrated red onion: flakes, chopped, minced, granules and powder
- Dehydrated garlic
- Fried onion and garlic
- Spices, herbs and seasonings
